description:
Turn your Mac desktop into a living album cover.

Vinyl Wallpaper transforms your screen with stunning animated artwork from your music. See every track come alive on a beautifully rendered turntable with a spinning record, tonearm, and live VU meters — right on your desktop.

FEATURES

• Multiple Visual Setups — Choose from album canvas, classic turntable deck, floating vinyl, listening room, Side A, and After Dark
• Notch Player — A sleek collapsible player that lives in your MacBook's notch with artwork, controls, and progress
• Multi-Source — Works with Spotify, WiiM streamers, Apple Music, and AirPlay. Auto-detects what's playing
• Live Progress & Controls — Track progress, play/pause, skip, and volume right from the wallpaper or notch
• Multi-Display Support — Each display gets its own independent wallpaper
• Private by Design — Everything runs locally on your Mac. No data is ever collected or shared
promotionalText: Your desktop, set to music. Stunning animated album artwork with turntable, notch player, and multi-source support.
